The Party Machine

About The Party Machine

The Party Machine is a feel-good pop, funk, soul, Motown and rock band bringing upbeat energy to weddings and parties across the UK. Originally formed to perform and travel the world, they’ve entertained crowds on Princess Cruises , Royal Caribbean and Carnival Cruise Lines , and now bring that same joy to dancefloors closer to home. Available as a 3 to 5 piece , their standard lineup features female lead vocals , guitar , and drums , with optional bass and keys for a bigger sound. With degrees in music and training from institutions like Canterbury University , ICMP , and the Sassari Conservatoire , this is a band with real musical chops and great chemistry. They’ve played festivals and venues including Rock City , Ronnie Scott’s , Alexandra Palace , and more. With a repertoire of 340+ songs , they’ll work with you to tailor the setlist, and arrive with full PA, lighting, and big smiles — ready to get the party going.
